title: Pan Dorobo TV Anime Announced for October 2026
description: Adaptation based on Keiko Shibata's picture book series broadcasts on NHK E TV
content: Keiko Shibata's popular children's picture book series  Pan Dorobo  (“The Bread Thief”) announced today that the series is being adapted into a TV anime that will broadcast on NHK E TV beginning in October 2026. A teaser trailer and teaser art as well as an  official website  and  social media feed  have been published for the series. title: Sgt. Frog New TV Anime Announced for 2026
description: New production will feature an entirely new cast
content: According to posts on  social media  and the  official home page  for the series, a new TV anime adaptation based on Mine Yoshizaki's  Sgt. Frog  comedy manga will debut in Japan in 2026. The series was previously adapted into a 358 episode TV anime that broadcast from April 2004 to April 2011. The new series will feature an entirely new cast of voice actors to portray the characters.
